proof_body:
by
  intro G _ g _
  have h := MulAction.index_stabilizer (ConjAct G) g
  rw [ConjAct.orbit_eq_carrier_conjClasses, ConjAct.stabilizer_eq_centralizer] at h
  have h2 : (ConjClasses.mk g).carrier = {x : G | IsConj g x} := by
    ext x
    rw [ConjClasses.mem_carrier_iff_mk_eq, ConjClasses.mk_eq_mk_iff_isConj]
    exact isConj_comm
  rw [h2] at h
  exact h.symm
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] (g : G), {x : G | IsConj g x}.Finite → Set.ncard {x : G | IsConj g x} = (Subgroup.centralizer ({g} : Set G)).index
